Specification of Communication Management
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
[SWS_CM_00233] Behavior of a ServiceSkeleton over a secure channel using a
reliable transport protocol before the secure channel is established
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00804
⌈
The middleware shall ensure a secure channel has been successfully established for
each proxy, for which a secure channel is configured before sending data.
Therefore, invocation of the following methods shall not result in sending data to a
proxy for which a secure channel is configured but not established:
• the
Send()
method of the respective
Event
class (see [SWS_CM_00162])
• the
Send()
method of the respective
Trigger
class (see [SWS_CM_00721])
• the
Update()
method of the respective
Field
class (see [SWS_CM_00119])
In case the chosen security protocol is able to protect Service Discovery this shall
additionally apply to the service discovery API
OfferService
.
